description: The two pie charts represent the distribution of different categories related to task performance, with the left chart showing four categories and the right chart showing four categories as well. The left chart has four slices: "Atomic Skill Fail" (dark blue, 68.0%), "Correct" (blue, 12.0%), "Reason Error" (light blue, 8.0%), and another slice labeled "12.0%" (very light blue). The right chart also has four slices: "Question Misunderstood" (light blue, 55.0%), "Reason Error" (very light blue, 21.0%), "Atomic Skill Fail" (blue, 14.0%), and "Correct" (dark blue, 10.0%). Both charts include percentage labels inside the slices, and a legend is provided at the top to distinguish between the categories using different shades of blue. The slices in both charts are not visually emphasized or ordered in a particular way.
